title: Logistics shipments
goal: Show shipment fulfilment, packages, carrier legs, and delivery proof in a logistics domain.

rubric.must: Sales Order visibly has a one-to-many fulfilment relationship to Shipment.
Shipment visibly contains Packages and has one or more Shipment Legs.
Carrier visibly operates many Shipment Legs.
Shipment visibly relates to a dispatching Warehouse and Sales Order visibly relates to an Address.
Shipment visibly has an optional Delivery Proof relationship.
Primary and foreign key markings are visible in the entity fields.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the erd exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target visibly includes all requested entities, relationships, and key markings. Connections are traceable, labels are readable, and no material overlap or cropping is apparent.

items.evidence: SALES_ORDER connects to SHIPMENT with exactly-one at the order end and one-or-many at the shipment end; labeled “fulfils.”
SHIPMENT connects to PACKAGE and SHIPMENT_LEG; each shows one-or-many at the child end and exactly-one at the shipment end.
CARRIER connects to SHIPMENT_LEG with one-or-many at the leg end and exactly-one at the carrier end; labeled “operates.”
WAREHOUSE connects to SHIPMENT via “dispatches,” and ADDRESS connects to SALES_ORDER via “delivers_to.” Both show one-or-many at the shipment/order end and exactly-one at the warehouse/address end.
SHIPMENT connects to DELIVERY_PROOF via “confirms,” with an optional proof at the proof end and exactly one shipment at the other end.
Primary keys have visible blue PK badges and foreign keys have orange FK badges in the entity fields.
